operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.controlledAbsence: fatal identity failure; never a negative field claim
operations.privacySecurity: Public structured metadata only; descriptions, topics, authorization headers, and raw bodies are not committed.
operations.completenessSemantics: Exact identity supplies a total archived Boolean at collectedAt. A recognized non-null primary language supplies one partial language/ecosystem fact; null or unsupported values remain unknown.

operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.sourceMutability: mutable branch reference resolved to an immutable commit object ID
operations.privacySecurity: Public Git reference identity only; no raw body is retained.
operations.evidenceProvenance: intermediate exact-head identity binding; evidence uses the validated commit object
operations.completenessSemantics: The ref must exactly equal refs/heads/{defaultBranch}, its object type must be commit, and its SHA becomes the only allowed commit-object request identity.

operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.sourceMutability: immutable Git commit object selected by the validated branch reference
operations.privacySecurity: Public commit and root-tree identity plus dates only; no diff, files array, message, author identity, email, or raw body is retained.
operations.completenessSemantics: The commit SHA must equal the reference object SHA. The bounded commit object supplies the immutable head SHA and root tree SHA under ADR 0006 semantics.

operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.sourceMutability: mutable query bound to immutable head and closed time window
operations.paginationRule: per_page=1; a valid Link last-page number proves the count, no Link with zero or one result proves 0 or 1, and every other state is qualified unknown
operations.controlledAbsence: a complete empty result is established zero commits
operations.privacySecurity: No commit messages or contributor personal data are retained.
operations.completenessSemantics: Only a closed-window pagination state establishes an exact count, including zero.

operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.controlledAbsence: established no detected license, but license identity remains unknown because the value type has no absence variant
operations.privacySecurity: Public structured classification only; license content and raw body are not retained.
operations.completenessSemantics: A recognized non-NOASSERTION SPDX value supplies one positive license fact; non-detection remains unknown.

operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.controlledAbsence: qualified unknown unless a successful payload supplies the complete security_policy Boolean
operations.privacySecurity: Public Boolean only; content, URLs, and raw bodies are not retained.
operations.completenessSemantics: A successful normalized Boolean establishes present or absent at collectedAt.

operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.paginationRule: one five-record page; a short page is closed, while a full page may retain matching positive releases but cannot establish completeness
operations.controlledAbsence: only a complete empty release page is established no release
operations.privacySecurity: Public release metadata only; raw bodies and temporary URLs are not retained.
operations.completenessSemantics: A selected non-draft record supplies positive direct evidence even when the field remains partial; only a closed empty set establishes null.

operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.paginationRule: at most two 100-item pages; any further page makes completeness partial while exact matching observed advisories remain positive direct evidence
operations.controlledAbsence: only a complete zero-result exact query is established zero applicable advisories
operations.privacySecurity: Public advisory identifiers and severity only; raw bodies are not retained.
operations.completenessSemantics: Observed exact matching advisories are affirmative partial evidence; only closed pagination establishes count, severity maximum, or zero.

operations.sourceMutability: mutable index containing exact immutable versions
operations.controlledAbsence: fatal identity failure for a mapped catalog package; optional entry-point or peer-property omission is not field absence
operations.privacySecurity: Public package metadata only; scripts, tarballs, source, and candidate code are never fetched or executed.
operations.completenessSemantics: An exact explicit exports, main, or module entry point proves only an importable runtime package surface. An exact controlled peer dependency proves only the registered framework peer relation. Publication alone, runtime dependencies, and omission do not establish adoption architecture, compatibility, or datastore requirements.

operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.controlledAbsence: exact-ref 404 is optional exact-path source absence only; compose.json is not documented as a normal default filename and absence never establishes a deployment negative
operations.privacySecurity: Public inert data only; maximum decoded content is 262144 bytes and is never executed.
operations.completenessSemantics: A present normal root file is only a positive-source candidate until tree, blob, strict JSON, and repository-root self-build service checks agree.

operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.controlledAbsence: missing exact compose.json and/or Dockerfile entries are path-specific source absence only and never deployment negatives
operations.privacySecurity: Only exact root compose.json and Dockerfile entry metadata are retained; no recursive tree or unrelated path metadata are retained.
operations.completenessSemantics: The exact root tree is fetched once. A source candidate requires one normal 100644 or 100755 blob entry at exact path compose.json or Dockerfile; each retained SHA controls its immutable blob request.

operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.controlledAbsence: missing, invalid, unsupported, services-empty, or generic services without repository-root build context yield qualified field unknown and never a negative claim
operations.privacySecurity: Strict UTF-8 JSON is parsed inertly with 262144 decoded-byte, 100000-node, and depth-32 limits; no commands, scripts, images, or candidate code are run.
operations.completenessSemantics: Content and Git blob digest must agree. Only a service with build context exactly dot emits repository-self-build-compose-service; generic image or dependency services do not. Complete deployment semantics remain unresolved.

operations.authentication: later-authorized injected bearer token; never retained
operations.paginationRule: none; requested only when the already-fetched exact root tree contains one normal Dockerfile blob entry
operations.controlledAbsence: missing root-tree entry is source absence and emits no negative; a tree-declared blob that cannot be retrieved or matched is never established absence
operations.privacySecurity: Exact root Dockerfile bytes are inert untrusted data, capped at 262144 decoded bytes, strict UTF-8, NUL-free, never executed, never built, and never sent to a registry.
operations.completenessSemantics: Repository, commit, root-tree, path, normal mode/type, tree/blob SHA, recomputed Git object identity, decoded byte length, UTF-8 bytes, and source digest must agree. Only a conservative direct FROM prefix emits repository-container-build-declaration; absence or unsupported syntax emits no fact.

freshnessPolicy.mutableSources: retain collectedAt, effectiveAsOf, source identity, source record digest, completeness including partial, and source-is-mutable limitation
freshnessPolicy.immutableSources: bind exact commit, root tree, blob, release, advisory, or package version
freshnessPolicy.partialEvidence: retain source and field completeness separately plus explicit unresolved remainder
freshnessPolicy.replayClock: committed cutoff only; ambient time is prohibited

publicationFlow: pure offline complete-profile and registry-validated partial-evidence projection
separate planned-capability, realized-readiness, full-closure, realized-breadth, and per-cell-origin report
